Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

Due to the way individuals see colors, the differences in color computer monitors and cameras there may be slight variations and or differences between the actual item and the photographs. There are no returns accepted on any item for color variation.
TESTING:
All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.
We describe each item to the best of our ability; however, we are
NOT
experts in any field. All gemstones are measured using electronic calipers.
All gemstones are tested on a Presidium Gemstone Tester. This equipment CANNOT determine between natural, lab created and synthetic gemstones. There are no returns accepted for lab created or synthetic gemstones.
Items may be vintage, antique or newer. There is still a chance that the stones can become loose or that a connector may need to be tightened. We are as delicate as possible with the items, but there is a possibility we may miss the flaw or that it may happen during shipment. TERMINOLOGY USED IN OUR LISTINGS:

stone(s)
can be anything at all. It is only being used as more of a descriptive word/placeholder. These can be anything from genuine gemstone, lab created, synthetic, glass, plastic or crystal "stones". Please make sure you understand and take that into account before placing a bid.
Pearls are tested to the best of our ability for texture and layering. They are not professionally tested. Pearls that do not pass the texture and layering test are labeled "faux". The approximate diameter is provided for size only, and the pearl(s) may or may not be perfectly round. 90% of the world's pearls are now cultured and are not naturally occurring. Color, when we describe the color (of a stone, gem, bead, or anything that is described by a color), we may have different lighting than you & some of us see colors differently. Please know that the color that is described could be slightly different & a return will not be accepted for this reason.

description:
Arizona Petrified Wood
Polished Fossil Slab Display Specimen
Late Triassic Period
Originating from northeastern Arizona, this petrified wood slab dates to the Late Triassic period, over 200 million years ago. Silica replaced buried wood fibers while iron and manganese oxides imparted rich tones of brick red, amber, and black. The piece showcases fine fossilization with a polished face and authentic rough outer bark.
Polished display face highlighting mineral banding and grain structure
Natural rough rind preserving the exterior tree bark texture
Flat cut bottom with four protective cork pads for upright display
Includes educational informational card on Arizona petrified wood
Dimensions: 7.2" H x 6.6" W x 2.2" D; Weight: 1.65 lbs
Condition:
Polished surface is smooth with natural internal micro-fissures inherent to fossilized stone. Natural rough edges are intact. Base is cut flat and stands upright securely; partial label residue on underside. Information card has handling creases.

shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

description: This listing includes two mineral and crystal collectibles. The first is a cluster of light blue quartz crystals with a natural prismatic formation and semi-translucent appearance. The second is a geode keychain featuring a sliced and polished agate geode with a crystalline interior in gray, white, and black tones, attached to a metal key ring and chain. Both items show natural variations and minor roughness consistent with mineral specimens and are in good used condition.

description: This listing includes a natural orange creedite puffball cluster specimen weighing 9.9 grams. The creedite specimen features a radiating, spiky formation of translucent to orange crystals with a well-defined, intricate structure typical of the mineral. The mineral specimen exhibits a three puff ball formation, measuring 37mm x 23mm x 20mm in total size. This piece suitable for mineral collectors or as display specimen, offering unique textures and natural aesthetics.

description: This lot includes two raw apophyllite mineral specimens. The left specimen measures 3x2.5x1 inches and the right specimen measures 2.5x1.5x1.25 inches. Both crystals have a colorless to milky white appearance with transparent to translucent qualities and well-defined hexagonal faces. The larger cluster is roughly oval-shaped while the smaller one is more irregular. Natural matrix is present on the underside, with one piece showing greenish mineralization. The combined weight of both specimens is 232.8 grams. These specimens are in raw, unpolished condition. Due to the softer nature and raw edges of apophyllite, flaking or cracks on the edges may be present. No obvious damage is noted. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.

description:
Hand-Carved Wooden Figurine
Man Smoking Pipe Folk Art Sculpture
Carved Solid Wood, 28 Inches
This hand-carved wooden folk art sculpture depicts a standing bearded man wearing a wide-brimmed hat and rustic attire, smoking a pipe and carrying a curved horn. Rendered from solid wood, the piece features expressive facial carving, rhythmic gouge work, and contrasting dark-stained accents that highlight the organic grain and textures of the timber. Large-scale figurative carvings of this style reflect traditional vernacular woodworking traditions and make compelling additions to rustic, global, or folk art collections.
Hand-carved solid timber construction with chiseled gouge details
Depicts a standing elder figure with pipe, brimmed hat, and shoulder strap
Natural warm wood tone accented with black-stained detailing
Integrated round pedestal base carved from the same solid block
Condition:
Structurally intact and stable on base. Natural age checking and drying cracks are visible on the hat brim and base underside, typical of solid wood carvings. Minor surface finish wear and light dust in recesses. No detached pieces or structural breaks.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
